working_definition: Unresolved medulla neurons derived from the outer proliferation center in the wandering third instar larval optic lobe (33 clusters), immature secondary neurons that will become adult optic lobe neurons.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.

justification: Curator decision: the wandering larval stage calls for an immature neuron term, and the unresolved medulla neurons are mapped to immature adult optic lobe neuron as a broad match. Medulla-specific immature neuron terms were not used because the authors' label does not resolve cell types.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Neuron that has its cell body in the adult optic lobe. These neurons develop from neuroblasts of the larval optic anlage (Hofbauer and Campos-Ortega, 1990).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; the larval cells are immature.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will have its synapses restricted to the optic lobe in the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Assumes intrinsic neurons only; the medulla neuron label is unresolved.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053539 immature adult optic lobe neuron (broad), per curator decision.
